title: SafetyPrompts: a Systematic Review of Open Datasets for Evaluating and Improving Large Language Model Safety
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a systematic review of datasets and does not introduce a new benchmark. It notes that some of the reviewed datasets measure sociodemographic bias, with religion being one of the categories of bias evaluated (e.g., in the dataset by Li et al., 2020).
findings: The paper's primary finding regarding religion is that it was a category of concern for early safety datasets, which were primarily focused on evaluating sociodemographic biases in language models. However, the review does not provide specific findings about the nature or extent of religious bias in any particular LLM.
